description_en: Restarts a node of a PolarDB cluster
kebab_example: aliyun polardb restart-db-node --db-node-id pi-0000000000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: RestartDBNode

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster node.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185342.html operation to query the details of all clusters under your account, including node IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群节点ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185342.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括节点ID
parameters.name: db_node_id

parameters.help_en:
The earliest time to start the scheduled node restart. The task is executed within a specified time window. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format and in UTC.

The start time can be set to any point in time within the next 72 hours. For example, if the current time is `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`, the start time can be set to a value in the range from `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z` to `2021-01-17T09:00:00Z`.

If this parameter is empty, the node is restarted immediately
parameters.help_zh:
开始执行定时（即在目标时间段内执行）重启节点任务的最早时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
开始时间的取值范围为未来72小时内的任意时间点。例如当前时间为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`，此处允许填入的开始时间范围为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`~`2021-01-17T09:00:00Z`。
若该参数留空，默认立即执行重启节点任务
parameters.name: planned_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The latest time to start the scheduled task. The time must be in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format and in UTC.

The latest time must be at least 30 minutes later than the earliest time.

If PlannedStartTime is specified but this parameter is not, the latest start time of the task is PlannedStartTime plus 30 minutes by default. For example, if PlannedStartTime is set to `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z` and this parameter is empty, the task starts no later than `2021-01-14T09:30:00Z`
parameters.help_zh:
开始执行目标定时任务的最晚时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
最晚时间需晚于开始时间的30分钟或以上。
若设置了`PlannedStartTime`但未指定该参数，执行目标任务的最晚时间默认为`开始时间+30分钟`。例如当设置`PlannedStartTime`为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`且该参数留空时，目标任务最晚将于`2021-01-14T09:30:00Z`开始执行
parameters.name: planned_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to restart the node immediately or at a scheduled time. Valid values:

false (default): The node is restarted at a scheduled time.

true: The node is restarted immediately
parameters.help_zh:
立即执行或定时执行重启节点任务。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：定时执行

true：立即执行
parameters.name: from_time_service

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query the available regions
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html接口查看可用地域
parameters.name: region_id
